en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a wide market square lined with multi‑storey townhouses and shops. On the left stands a large Baroque-style church with twin towers and a prominent entrance portal. A tall square tower is visible further back on the right. People walk along the street and several early automobiles are parked. The main printed caption at the top reads "Komotau. Markt." with large stamped numbers "65718" and a handwritten year-like annotation in red ink.
